La duda tiene todo el sentido del mundo porque en GTA 5 se podía, aunque no de salida. La anterior entrega se lanzó en septiembre de 2013 y dicha opción no llegó hasta un año después, en noviembre de 2014. Volviendo a GTA 6, la respuesta es curiosa. items.title: Holding well: The operating discipline behind longer African hold periods
items.description: DealMakers AFRICA recorded 76 private equity transactions in the first half of 2026, compared with 136 transactions recorded during 2023. Its Q2 analysis points to a more cautious investment environment and to the persistent difficulty of achieving exits on the continent.
items.excerpt: By Hukun Dabar Founder, Chairman & Principal Consultant | Minken Investment Ltd / Minken AfricaTuesday November 17, 2026 Africa's exit constraints are usually discussed as a fund-structuring or transaction problem. But when an asset remains in a portfolio for longer than planned, another question becomes equally important: what operating discipline is required to preserve value, improve the business and keep it genuinely exit-ready?
